scientific_integrity: Proof is algebraic with arbitrary prime-power quantifiers. Numerical tests are reproducibility checks only; no external or independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only the constant plus one-coordinate nonzero additive characters are classified; higher-frequency interaction bands and general frequency subsets are not covered.
Published full additive character-sum formulas are important known ingredients; independent historical novelty assessment has not been performed.
One potentially relevant 2014 conference predecessor was available only as a bibliographic abstract; its later, expanded arXiv treatment was inspected in relevant sections.
Finite numerical tests support, but cannot establish, the all-prime-power theorem.
title: Four-level Fourier frame spectrum on determinant-one matrices over finite fields
